description: This file defines the CustomDosingInstructions class, which implements the DosingInstructions interface for handling dosing instructions related to drug orders in the OpenMRS system. It includes method implementations related to retrieving and setting dosing instructions, validation, and expiry date handling.

classes.name: CustomDosingInstructions
classes.description: A class implementing the DosingInstructions interface, providing custom behavior for managing drug dosing instructions within OpenMRS.

methods.name: getDosingInstructionsAsString
methods.description: Returns the dosing instructions as a string for a given locale (currently returns null).

methods.name: setDosingInstructions
methods.description: Sets dosing instructions based on a DrugOrder object (currently an empty implementation).

methods.name: getDosingInstructions
methods.description: Retrieves dosing instructions based on a DrugOrder object, returning this instance.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a DrugOrder object, specifically checking that the 'brandName' field is not null.

methods.name: getAutoExpireDate
methods.description: Returns the automatic expiry date for a given DrugOrder (currently returns null).
